text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mubarak says after opening new medical centre that state's primary concern is providing free treatment for the poor. He says most important thing in Middle East peace process is to remove reasons behind violence.
- Three messages from Mubarak to be delivered by Prime Minister Ganzouri to leaders of Malaysia, Singapore and China.
- Ministerial committee for privatisation bars public sector companies from expanding investment base.
- Foreign Minister Moussa says in Kuwait that Arabs will never approve peace that benefits only Israel.
- Mubarak says cutting ties with Israel will not benefit peace process.
- Ministerial committee for privatisation puts up for sale shares in 42 comapnies by April 26.
- Taxi driver who refused to take passenger to destination sentenced to six months in prison.
- Agriculture Minister Youssef Wali says Egypt tops world's production in sugar cane.
- 42,000 Cairenes have mobile telephones; system to be introduced to Alexandria this month.
